Description
Rectangular granite freestanding stone of remembrance. Lettering is carved in black.
Inscription
STIRLING BOMBER OF/ 149 SQDN RAF/ CRASHED HERE WITH/ THE LOSS OF/ 7 AIRCREW ON THE/ 21ST AUGUST 1942/ CREW:/ (Names)/ WE WILL REMEMBER THEM
